description: Land Title Settlement Department - Galbokka, Ridimaliyadda D/S Division, Badulla District - Cad. Map No. 710016
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land (Parcel Nos. 134 and 169), including details about land ownership, extent, location, and title classification. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
